searchText: do you know why BLS withdrawal credentials were introduced in the first place, then? it seems ETH1 is the "obvious" approach At the time that bls withdrawal creds were made the default, the current plan for merging eth1/eth2 hadn’t emerged as the path forward yet. So wasn’t as obvious that eth1 creds were the way to do it Seems reasonable! The more I consider it the more that it makes sense with the current direction of the merge. I don't see any value in a BLS withdrawal key unless it has some additional privileges around future operations.
